tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a specified product and selected variant options (size, color, quantity) to the user's active shopping cart in local storage.

size.description: Selected size option if applicable (e.g. 'One Size', 'M', 'L')

product_id.description: The ID of the product to add (e.g. 'space-explorer', 'origin-tote')

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Inspect all line items currently in the shopping cart, including selected options, unit prices, total item count, and formatted subtotal.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive product details by product ID or URL, including title, price, descriptions, materials, specifications, variant options, stock count, rating, and gallery images.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all product departments and categories in the nekuda store with catalog counts and descriptions.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Discover and search products in the nekuda store with optional keyword search, category filter, tag filter, sort ordering, stock filter, and pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 20)

query.description: Keyword search for product title, description, or tags

category.description: Filter by category name or slug (e.g. 'hats', 'apparel', 'drinkware', 'desk-office', 'tech', 'bags', 'limited')

in_stock_only.description: When true, returns only items currently in stock

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List physical nekuda store flagships and pickup point locations with addresses, opening hours, and available services.

city.description: Filter by city name (e.g. 'Tel Aviv', 'New York', 'London')
